change_summary: Added a one-line EFFICIENCY rule permitting batched parallel read-only lookups in a single turn.
reason_for_change: Tasks 103 and 8 show the agent issuing get_order_details and get_product_details across separate turns, each adding a round-trip and raising mean turn count (26.9). A single concise batching instruction in the already-accepted compact checklist reduces round-trips/turns—lowering mean cost per task—while preserving success since the same lookups still occur, just consolidated.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.495164 >= threshold 0.448779 (best mean 0.479572 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The policy_summary checklist still omits a rule to batch independent read-only lookups in one assistant turn; explicitly permitting parallel tool calls for order/product lookups will reduce turn count (mean 26.9) since the agent currently issues lookups across separate turns.
